narr: A very moist atmosphere, and some merging and training heavy showers and thunderstorms, produced locally heavy rain and flooding in Orangeburg Co SC.
ev: A flooded and impassable roadway was reported at Brookside Dr and Riverside Dr in Orangeburg. Observations from around the area indicated about 4 to 6 inches of rain fell over this region. Street flooding was also observed in a few other parts of the town of Orangeburg.
lsr: FLOODED IMPASSABLE ROADWAYS ON BROOKSIDE AND RIVERSIDE DR IN ORANGEBURG.
